title: ZPA builder, reader, analysis, overview and Path stage
standards: WSTG INPV-01, INPV-13, ATHZ-02, ATHZ-04, BUSL-01, BUSL-05, BUSL-06, BUSL-07, ERRH-01, INFO-05

checks.what: create, re-run is a no-op, update in place, prefix delete, Undo restore
create/update/delete re-read before writing; plan_changed when the tenant moved
shown once, never in plan, result, log, audit or record; same actor; ten minutes
required and validated before any ZPA call
exact, longest wildcard, longest prefix; ports, UDP/TCP, apex, disabled, ties
Always / On-Net / VPN, intercept, intercept accessible, bypass
first match, disabled skipped, posture pass and fail, default deny
every page read; incomplete never planned from
every create payload field and rule action known to zscaler-sdk-python 1.11.3
CSV, ports, prefix, specs, restore entries, destinations
a prefix never reaches another build's objects
errors and logs redact keys and tokens
the reader calls only list_* methods
redaction patterns run on bounded text
write mode and the previewed plan hash at the engine

findings.title: Prefix delete and policy rules of prefix 'pov' took the objects of another build 'pov-2' (names also start with 'pov-')
findings.fix: Another build's longer prefix is recognised from the builder's fixed object names and excluded (deny by default).

findings.title: ZPA reader stopped at a short page even when totalPages said more, and trusted the SDK's default totalPages=1: large tenants silently truncated
findings.fix: The page body's totalPages decides; only when no total is stated does a short page end the list; an empty page always ends it.

findings.title: ZPA builder planned from a list cut at the page limit (duplicates created, objects to delete missed)
findings.fix: An incomplete list is a read error: the plan is refused.

findings.title: ZPA reader and builder called ZPA with an SDK client whose customer ID was missing or invalid (/customers/None/...)
findings.fix: customer_id_problem() refuses a missing or non-alphanumeric (>64) customer ID before any ZPA call.

findings.title: Bulk changes routes for ZPA builder types do not check the OneAPI sign-in and customer ID before signing in
findings.fix: _ops_zpa_gate (400 before sign-in for a classic-API sign-in or a missing/invalid customer ID) on the six /api/operations routes and the Undo preview; admin_ops.product_of names a type's product; the ops request models take the customer_id the page already sent (it was dropped)

findings.title: SDK error text could carry a provisioning key value into logs and results (only bearer/token/secret/password were redacted)
findings.fix: Provisioning-key shaped values and provisioningKey/api_key fields are replaced by [hidden]; the text is cut before redaction.

findings.title: ZPA builder accepted 0.0.0.0/0, ::/0 and /8 subnets from a CSV: segments its own analysis reports as over-broad (high)
findings.fix: Subnets wider than IPv4 /9 or IPv6 /33 are refused with their size.

findings.title: Tenant port strings such as '²' or 5,000 digits made int() raise and ended the whole ZPA read
findings.fix: Ports are parsed from 1-5 ASCII digits within 0-65535; anything else is skipped.

findings.title: Connector versions mixing text and numbers ('23.1', 'beta.1') raised TypeError in the analysis and the overview
findings.fix: Version keys are (0, number) or (1, text) parts, always comparable.

findings.title: Non-finite connector times ('NaN', 'inf') hid a stale, disconnected connector
findings.fix: epoch_seconds returns None for non-finite values.

findings.title: Destination ports written with non-ASCII digits answered Python's int() error instead of a plain sentence
findings.fix: Inline and field ports are ASCII digits; a bad bracketed-IPv6 port is refused in words.

findings.title: IDN host names were refused (diagnosis, Path analyzer and builder) instead of compared in their punycode form
findings.fix: Hosts and segment entries are compared, and the builder stores entries, in punycode.

findings.title: Diagnosis 'why not matched' text was wrong for negated application conditions, OR-joined rules and operands the tool cannot evaluate
findings.fix: Each case has its own sentence; unevaluable operands say 'this tool cannot evaluate', not 'you left as any'.

findings.title: Path analyzer said an On-Net segment bypasses ZPA on a trusted network when the device was off network
findings.fix: The On-Net reason is given only for network 'on'; otherwise the forwarding/access reason.

findings.title: Over-broad check (ZPA-AS-04) flagged no IPv6 subnet except ::/0 (2000::/3 passed clean)
findings.fix: IPv6 /32 or wider is high, /48 or wider medium.

findings.title: ZPA overview workbook rebuilt all seven tables twice per sheet
findings.fix: Tables are built once per workbook.

findings.title: admin_ops.execute does not itself require a named assessor (the route does): no defence in depth for the write gate
findings.fix: admin_ops.execute refuses a blank assessor (OperationError) right after the write-mode check, before the client is touched; table-driven over every operation type

findings.title: Overlapping port ranges in one CSV row (80-90, 85-95) are sent as given, not merged
findings.fix: Accepted: whether ZPA refuses overlapping ranges in one segment is not verifiable without a tenant; ZPA's own answer is shown.

findings.title: A wildcard on a public suffix such as *.co.uk is not recognised as over-broad
findings.fix: Accepted: needs the public suffix list, which the app does not ship; single-label TLD wildcards are refused.
